kmscon.why: Userspace KMS console emulator that draws a terminal on the framebuffer. Full-screen display counts; deep cut suits Heisenbug.

Zutty.why: Named X11 terminal emulator with a GPU renderer. Specialist knowledge, so Heisenbug fits.

Warp.why: GPU-accelerated terminal app known by its project name, which the scope's In rule covers. Developers know it well but it is not universal, so Null pointer exception fits.

GNOME Terminal.why: VTE-based GNOME desktop terminal, named in scope. Nearly everyone on GNOME names it first.

Tilix.why: GTK tiling terminal emulator, named in scope. Many Linux users know it, so Null pointer exception fits.

Sakura.why: Lightweight GTK/VTE terminal emulator. Domain users know it, so Memory leak fits.

pyte.why: Python terminal emulator library, named in scope as an emulation library. Specialist knowledge, so Heisenbug fits.

kterm.why: Historical Japanese X11 terminal emulator (Kanji terminal). Scope allows historical programs. Deep cut, so Heisenbug fits.

Eterm.why: Enlightenment X11 terminal emulator, named in scope. Domain users know it, so Memory leak fits.

hterm.why: Chrome OS web terminal, named in scope as embedded and web. Specialist knowledge, so Heisenbug fits.

GNOME Console.why: GNOME's terminal app (kgx), a VTE-based desktop terminal. Known to GNOME users, so Memory leak fits.

Tabby.why: Electron-based terminal app, formerly Terminus. Named program with a project name. Memory leak fits.

Terminal.app.why: macOS built-in terminal emulator, named in scope. Nearly everyone on a Mac names it first.

kitty.why: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator, named in scope by project name. Widely known, so Off-by-one fits.

PuTTY.why: Named terminal emulator and SSH client, which scope keeps In. Widely known, so Memory leak fits.

Terminology.why: Enlightenment's EFL terminal emulator. Specialist knowledge, so Race condition fits.

Blackbox Terminal.why: GNOME terminal emulator app by its project name. Niche, so Heisenbug fits.

xst.why: Named extended fork of suckless st, a terminal emulator in its own right. Deep cut, so Heisenbug fits.

ZOC.why: Commercial terminal emulator and SSH client by name. Niche, so Heisenbug fits.

iTerm2.why: macOS terminal emulator, named in scope. Nearly everyone on a Mac names it first, so Off-by-one fits.
